# The tree the mandatory-deny tests walk, one entry per line.
#
#   path/            a directory
#   path             an empty file
#   path = text      a file with that text
#   path -> target   a symbolic link
#
# git will not store a `.git` directory, so the tests build this tree from the
# list. Names that differ only in case sit in different directories, since a
# macOS volume does not tell them apart.

# Every dangerous file, hidden, at the root.
.bashrc
.bash_profile
.gitconfig
.gitmodules
.zshrc
.zprofile
.profile
.ripgreprc
.mcp.json
readme.md

# Case variants of a file, of directories, and of the hooks of a repository.
case/file/.BashRC
case/vscode/.VSCODE/settings.json
case/idea/.Idea/workspace.xml
case/commands/.Claude/COMMANDS/review.md
case/agents/.CLAUDE/agents/planner.md
case/hooks/.Git/HOOKS/pre-commit
case/head/.GIT/Head
case/config/.git/CONFIG

# A repository, with files that are not dangerous beside the ones that are.
repo/.git/HEAD
repo/.git/config
repo/.git/hooks/pre-commit
repo/.git/hooks/sub/post-merge
repo/.git/objects/pack/pack-1
repo/.git/refs/heads/main
repo/src/main.rs

# A worktree keeps a file where a repository keeps a directory.
worktree/.git = gitdir: /elsewhere
worktree/.claude/settings.json

# Nothing here hides a file.
.gitignore = ignored/
.ignore = ignored/
.rgignore = ignored/
ignored/.bashrc
ignored/.vscode/settings.json

# node_modules is pruned by exact name, but rg lists what is directly in it.
node_modules/.bashrc
node_modules/pkg/.bashrc
node_modules/.vscode/.bashrc
node_modules/.zshrc/.profile
.vscode/node_modules/.bashrc
packages/node_modules/.vscode/settings.json
packages/node_modules/pkg/.git/hooks/pre-commit
other/Node_Modules/.vscode/settings.json

# A symbolic link is a name and nothing more.
real/.bashrc
real/.vscode/settings.json
linked -> real
sub/.vscode -> ../real/.vscode
sub/.zprofile -> ../real/.bashrc
dangling/.profile -> missing

# A dangerous name that is a directory lists nothing unless it holds a file.
dirs/.zshrc/inner
dirs/.bashrc/
dirs/.vscode/

# Depth: a file, a directory and a repository at each level of a chain.
chain/.bashrc
chain/.vscode/s
chain/.git/HEAD
chain/c1/.bashrc
chain/c1/.vscode/s
chain/c1/.git/HEAD
chain/c1/.git/config
chain/c1/c2/.bashrc
chain/c1/c2/.vscode/s
chain/c1/c2/.git/HEAD
chain/c1/c2/.git/config
chain/c1/c2/c3/.bashrc
chain/c1/c2/c3/.vscode/s
chain/c1/c2/c3/.git/HEAD
chain/c1/c2/c3/c4/.bashrc
chain/c1/c2/c3/c4/.vscode/s
chain/c1/c2/c3/c4/c5/.mcp.json
